title: Slot claim P3 hardening batch
description: Small verified items from the 3-perspective review, one session: (1) register_gateway -ENOMEM at :501 ignored - seq burned, no entry, ACCEPTED returned; (2) replay-gate TOCTOU - lookup outside s_coord_lock, commit inside, concurrent same-seq claims both pass and last-write regresses high-water; move lookup+commit inside one lock or commit conditionally; (3) claim_seq wrap UINT32_MAX->0 permanently locks the gateway out - use wrap-aware compare; (4) 4.09 conflict echo can be stale - entry may change between winner capture and snapshot memcpy, take both under one lock; (5) shared static resp buffers in slots_post/slots_get/info_get/channels_get corrupt under per-transport concurrency; (6) claim->mode assigned from uninitialized local on claim_dec_u8 failure (:1168-1176, UB-adjacent); (7) s_discard_count non-atomic across contexts; (8) digest computed before key lookup (:387) - wasted SHA-256 on unknown-IID floods; (9) rate limit is log-only - add admission control before decode once NV commit lands (flash-wear), and non-shortest CBOR uint encodings are accepted by the decoder (reject).
